description: This file is a PHP class implementation for Microsoft SQL Server data dictionary functionality within the ADOdb library. It defines the ADODB2_mssql class responsible for SQL syntax generation, type mapping, and schema modifications specific to MSSQL.

classes.name: ADODB2_mssql
classes.description: A PHP class handling MSSQL-specific schema operations, type conversions, and SQL command generation for the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps a generic type to a MSSQL-specific type code.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual MSSQL data type for a given type code.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add columns to a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix for column definitions, including defaults, nullability, and auto-increment.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating or dropping indexes.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the size of data types based on parameters.
